enabled.description: Enable or disable the ticket system, its /ticket and /tickets commands and the dashboard section.

staffNotifyEnabled.description: Notify online staff in chat when a ticket is created or a player replies.

creatorNotifyEnabled.description: Notify the ticket creator in chat when staff reply or the ticket is resolved, closed or reopened.

maxOpenTicketsPerPlayer.description: Maximum number of tickets a player may have in a non-resolved, non-closed state. Set to 0 for unlimited.

createCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between ticket creations by the same player. Measured from their most recent ticket regardless of its status, so closing a ticket does not bypass the cooldown. Set to 0 to disable.

maxMessageLength.description: Maximum length of a single ticket message. Longer messages are rejected with a localized error.

maxSubjectLength.description: Maximum length of the subject derived from the first line of a new ticket.

allowPlayerUrgentPriority.description: Allow players without the paradigm.ticket.priority.urgent permission to set URGENT priority.

playerReopenWindowHours.description: How many hours after a ticket is resolved the creator may reopen it themselves. Closed tickets always require staff. Set to 0 to never allow player reopen.

autoCloseResolvedAfterHours.description: Automatically close RESOLVED tickets after this many hours without activity. 0 disables auto-close.

autoCloseWaitingPlayerAfterDays.description: Automatically close WAITING_PLAYER tickets after this many days without activity. 0 disables auto-close.

autoCloseSweepIntervalMinutes.description: How often the auto-close sweeper runs. Only scheduled when at least one auto-close threshold is above 0.

crossServerNotifyPollSeconds.description: How often this server polls the shared ticket event table so staff here are notified about tickets and replies that originated on another server. Requires a shared SQL provider; on JSON storage notifications are local to this server only. Set to 0 to disable polling.

listPageSize.description: How many tickets are shown per page by /ticket list and /tickets.

threadPreviewMessages.description: How many of the most recent messages /ticket view shows inline.

categories.description: Anything that does not fit another category.
Something on the server is not working as intended.
Items lost to a crash, bug or rollback.
Anything else you would like staff to look at.
